CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.

2. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

4. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

7. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.
   D. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

9. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)

11. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fabric Decoration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
